## What

Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Why

Explain the problem this change solves. Link the relevant ADR when applicable.

## Screenshots or recording

Include light-mode and dark-mode evidence for user-interface changes.

## How I tested it

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] Checked on iOS
- [ ] Checked on Android
- [ ] Checked with VoiceOver or TalkBack
- [ ] Checked at the largest supported font size

## Checklist

- [ ] No personally identifiable information is logged
- [ ] Tests were added or updated
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or decisions changed
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated modifications
